sections.title: Welcome to TrackLogs
sections.body: These terms govern your use of TrackLogs and its related features. The operator is identified below. Use the app in accordance with these terms and applicable law. The Privacy Policy explains how information is processed; these terms do not replace any consent required for a particular data use.

sections.title: Using the app
sections.body: TrackLogs lets you create things, trackers, and timestamped entries, view history, and schedule reminders. It works primarily with local storage and does not require a TrackLogs account. Do not interfere with the app or supporting systems, bypass security controls, or use the services unlawfully.

sections.title: Your records belong to you
sections.body: You retain rights to records and content you create. Using TrackLogs does not grant the operator a general right to publish your records or use them in advertising. Processing for requested app features and any separately disclosed research is described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Software and intellectual property
sections.body: The operator grants you a non-exclusive license to use TrackLogs for its intended purpose. Ownership of the app software, branding, and other operator-created materials remains with their respective owners. Do not redistribute or exploit those materials without permission, except where applicable law or an accompanying open-source license permits it.

sections.title: Local storage, backups, and restore
sections.body: You are responsible for choosing appropriate exports or backups for important records. Browser storage can be cleared or evicted, and device loss or uninstalling the app can affect local records. Optional native cloud backups use your own iCloud or Google Drive account and are subject to provider terms. Restore can replace current local records rather than merge them. Review the app confirmation before restoring or deleting backups.

sections.title: Reminders and AI suggestions
sections.body: Reminders depend on device permissions, operating-system scheduling, and device settings, and may be delayed or missed. Universal Input suggestions can be incomplete or incorrect; review names, values, dates, units, and tracker selections before saving. TrackLogs is a general recording tool and is not a substitute for professional advice or emergency services.

sections.title: Third-party services
sections.body: Some features rely on Apple, Google/Firebase, Google Cloud, Amplitude, or platform model services. Their availability and applicable terms may affect those features. Local tracking should remain usable when optional network services are unavailable. Data handling is described in the product Privacy Policy.

sections.title: Feedback
sections.body: If you voluntarily send suggestions about the app, the operator may use those suggestions to improve it without an obligation to compensate you. This permission does not grant general promotional rights to your private tracking records.

sections.title: Updates and service changes
sections.body: Features and software may change over time. Material changes to these terms should receive reasonable notice before taking effect, except where an urgent legal or security requirement requires earlier action. The revision and effective dates will be shown here. Discontinuation of hosted features does not authorize deletion of records stored on your device.

sections.title: Warranties and liability
sections.body: The app is provided with reasonable care, but uninterrupted operation, perfect accuracy, and prevention of every data loss cannot be guaranteed. To the extent permitted by applicable law, implied warranties may be excluded and liability for indirect or consequential losses may be limited. Nothing in these terms excludes mandatory consumer rights or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded. The operator must review appropriate jurisdiction-specific limitations before publication.

sections.title: General terms and contact
sections.body: If a provision is unenforceable, the remaining provisions continue to apply where possible. A delay in enforcing a right does not waive it. These terms do not create third-party beneficiary rights except where required by law. Operator identity, governing law, dispute procedures, effective date, and contact details must be confirmed before publication. Mandatory protections in your place of residence continue to apply.
